steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction; the default auction strategy is sufficient because the case does not specify one.
Provide the mandatory event title required before testing the sheet.
Select the first available auction template; the catalog cannot distinguish forward from other auction template direction without a supplied template name.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Verify that the delivery-location picker does not offer the invalid non-plant value.
Attempt to enter the invalid free-text delivery location.
Assert that the invalid value is not retained in the delivery-location cell.
